findings.title: Create 3 pencas back-to-back without rate-limit
findings.notes: All 3 created without rate-limit (R2 paper-cut 3 fix verified: limit 20->40). Pencas: Alpha (8 matches), Beta (8 matches), Gamma (7 matches).

findings.title: Auto-routing: cold '2-1' -> tap match -> reply lists all 3 pencas
findings.notes: Cold '2-1' showed list of pending matches. Tap on Flamengo vs Palmeiras (6390) replied 'Anotado en *Penca Alpha R3*, *Penca Beta R3*, *Penca Gamma R3*: Flamengo 2 - 1 Palmeiras'. Stashed-score + auto-routing combined work correctly across 3 pencas.

findings.title: State query confirms 3 prediction posts created (one per penca)
findings.notes: qa-sim state shows groups=[Alpha 6952, Beta 6967, Gamma 6979], predictions=23 (8+8+7) initially.

findings.title: mis-pencas shows correct pluralization
findings.notes: Reply: '1 jugador · N pronósticos' for each penca (singular form for 1, correct grammar). R2 paper-cut 1 fixed. Note: scenario in prompt mentioned '3 jugadores' but each penca only has the creator so '1 jugador' is correct singular.

findings.title: Cold score when all matches predicted -> 'ya pronosticaste todos' reply
findings.notes: FIX VERIFIED for new scores: cold '3-0' with everything predicted correctly replied 'Recibí *3-0* — pero ya pronosticaste todos los pendientes. Mandá el partido por nombre...'. Cold '2-1' second time (after '3-0') also produced the expected reply.

findings.title: Stash collision: cold-typed score matching the stashed last-used score silently re-applies
repro: Have 3 pencas with multiple pending matches.
Type '2-1' cold -> get list of pending matches.
Tap last pending match (e.g. River vs Boca) -> all predictions made with 2-1.
Now ALL matches are predicted. Stashed score is still 2-1.
findings.expected: Reply 'Recibí *2-1* — pero ya pronosticaste todos los pendientes. Mandá el partido por nombre...'
findings.actual: Reply '✅ Anotado en *Penca Alpha R3*, *Penca Beta R3*, *Penca Gamma R3*: River Plate 2 - 1 Boca Juniors' — silently re-applies the stash to the last-predicted match.
findings.workaround: Typing a different score (e.g. '3-0') produces the correct message. After typing any other score the bug clears.
findings.hypothesis: When all-predicted code path checks if the typed score equals the stashed score / pending-match score, it may be skipping the 'all done' branch and falling through to re-stamp. Look for stash comparison in score-handling in includes/class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php.

findings.title: Pluralization paper-cut: 'Te faltan *1* pronósticos' and '1 partidos'
repro: Reach a state where exactly 1 match is pending across all pencas.
findings.fix_hint: Wrap both 'pronósticos' and 'partidos' in a pluralize helper that switches based on count.

findings.title: Cold-score routing shows wrong competition label
findings.actual: List header shows '🥇 Libertadores 2026 — 2 partidos' even though all 3 pencas are libertadores-semana. The competition label in the pending-list section title disagrees with the user's actual competitions.
findings.expected: Section header should reflect the user's penca competition (📆 Libertadores semanal) or at least be consistent.
findings.hypothesis: Pending matches are grouped by underlying competition slug rather than by the user's joined-penca competition. Libertadores-semana matches may be also tagged libertadores-2026 in the source data.
